Summarise the supplied source text in at most 100 words. Be concise and objective.

summary: World Nuclear Association director-general Agneta Rising said nuclear power is essential to a clean, affordable and reliable energy system. She estimated that it avoids more than 2.5 billion tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions annually compared with fossil fuels. The industry’s Harmony Programme aims to add 1,000 GWe of nuclear capacity and supply 25% of global electricity by 2050. Rising called for fairer electricity markets, harmonised regulations and a broader approach to safety. At the 2019 World Energy Congress, the association planned to discuss nuclear energy and launch a white paper.
